results.title: Page served over HTTPS with no mixed content detected
Title is shorter than recommended
results.recommendation: Expand the title with descriptive, keyword-relevant terms.

results.title: Missing meta description
results.recommendation: Add a 70–160 character meta description summarizing the page.

results.title: Missing canonical link
results.detail: No <link rel="canonical"> found in the document head.
results.recommendation: Add a self-referential canonical to prevent duplicate-content ambiguity.

results.title: No robots meta or X-Robots-Tag (defaults to index, follow)
No Open Graph tags found
results.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type for richer social previews.

results.title: No Twitter Card tags found
results.recommendation: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> plus title/description/image.

results.title: H1: "Components for modern web frontends in Go."
All 1 image(s) have an alt attribute
2 <title> elements (expected 1)
results.recommendation: Keep exactly one — crawlers and social cards pick unpredictably when there are multiple.

results.title: No <meta name="theme-color"> declared
results.recommendation: Add `<meta name="theme-color" content="#…">` to colour the mobile browser UI chrome.

results.title: robots.txt allows Googlebot for this URL
No Sitemap directive in robots.txt
results.recommendation: Add `Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml` to robots.txt.

results.title: /llms.txt not found
results.detail: An /llms.txt file gives LLMs a curated entry point to your site's most important content.
results.recommendation: Consider adding /llms.txt per the llmstxt.org spec to improve discoverability for AI assistants.

results.title: No explicit rules for known AI crawlers in robots.txt
results.detail: Without rules, most AI crawlers will fall back to the wildcard user-agent block (or none).
results.recommendation: Decide explicitly whether you want to be cited by AI search; add rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, OAI-SearchBot.

results.title: No JSON-LD structured data found
results.recommendation: Add schema.org JSON-LD (Article, FAQPage, HowTo, Organization, etc.). AI search engines heavily favor structured content.

results.title: No author signal in metadata
results.recommendation: Add <meta name="author"> or schema.org "author" — strengthens E-E-A-T for AI citations.

results.title: No published/modified date metadata
results.recommendation: Add article:published_time and article:modified_time meta tags; freshness affects AI citation rates.

results.title: Page content looks thin
results.detail: AI search engines tend to cite substantive, in-depth pages.

results.title: Numeric/statistical mentions: 1
results.detail: GEO research finds statistics + citations significantly boost AI citation rates.

results.title: Question-style headings: 0 of 2
results.detail: Question-shaped headings improve match against natural-language AI queries.

results.title: Readability: 62.5 avg words/sentence, F-K grade 43.1
results.recommendation: Long sentences (>25 words) and grade level >14 reduce comprehension and AI extraction quality. Shorter prose helps both.

results.title: Authoritative citations: 0 of 4 external link(s)
results.detail: Princeton GEO research finds citations to primary sources boost AI citation rates.

results.title: Content-Encoding: gzip
results.recommendation: Brotli (`br`) typically saves ~15-25% over gzip; consider enabling it if your CDN supports it.

results.title: 1 render-blocking stylesheet(s) in <head>
results.recommendation: Inline critical CSS or load non-critical sheets with `media="print" onload="this.media='all'"`.

results.title: Likely LCP image not preloaded
results.recommendation: Consider `<link rel="preload" as="image" href="…" fetchpriority="high">` for above-the-fold hero images.

results.title: 1 without srcset/
results.recommendation: Use `srcset`/`sizes` (or a `<picture>` element) so browsers can pick an appropriately-sized variant.

results.title: Likely LCP image lacks fetchpriority="high"
results.recommendation: Add `fetchpriority="high"` to the LCP image so the browser prioritizes its download.

results.title: 1 missing width/height (CLS risk)
results.recommendation: Set explicit `width` and `height` so the browser reserves layout space (prevents shift).

results.title: 1 form control(s) without a label
results.recommendation: Wire `<label for>` to the input id, wrap the input in a `<label>`, or set `aria-label`.

results.title: No skip-link as the first focusable link in body
results.recommendation: Add a `Skip to content` as the first focusable element so keyboard users can bypass nav.

results.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security header
results.recommendation: Add `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains` to force HTTPS for repeat visitors.

results.title: No Content-Security-Policy set
results.recommendation: Add a CSP header to mitigate XSS and data-injection attacks.

results.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
results.recommendation: Add `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` to block MIME-type sniffing.

results.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
results.recommendation: Set a Referrer-Policy header (e.g. `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`) to control referer leakage.

results.title: No Permissions-Policy header set
results.recommendation: Consider a `Permissions-Policy` to lock down powerful features (camera, geolocation, microphone) you don't use.

results.title: No clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors)
results.recommendation: Set `X-Frame-Options: DENY` or a CSP `frame-ancestors` directive.
